##### Project general facts

Beverly Residence 2 is a contemporary residential development designed as a sanctuary of balance and well-being, where physical, mental, and emotional harmony are at the core of its concept. The architecture reflects a modern and refined design language, combining clean lines, functional layouts, and carefully optimised spaces that enhance openness and comfort. Every detail is thoughtfully considered to create a sense of spaciousness and luxury, while the grand lobby sets an elegant tone with curated furnishings, soft lighting, and a welcoming atmosphere.

The development offers a lifestyle focused on comfort, relaxation, and everyday wellbeing within a thoughtfully designed residential environment. The overall concept is centred around creating a peaceful and harmonious living experience, where residents can enjoy a calm atmosphere complemented by refined communal spaces. The design prioritises both aesthetics and functionality, ensuring that every area contributes to a sense of ease and elevated living throughout the community.

Inside, Beverly Residence 2 features minimalist interiors defined by sleek finishes, elegant materials, and carefully coordinated colour palettes that enhance the sense of modern luxury. Bathrooms and living spaces are finished with high-quality fittings, stylish fixtures, mirrors, and premium countertops that reflect attention to detail and design precision. Kitchens are fully equipped, combining functionality with contemporary style, while the residences are delivered fully furnished, offering a complete and ready-to-move-in living experience with thoughtfully selected interiors throughout.

##### Location description and benefits

Real estate in Jumeirah Village Circle is one of the most sought-after housing options. It is popular among both potential tenants and investors. About 2,000 housing units are available in the complex, which includes huge villas, townhouses, studio flats, and multi-bedroom apartments in high-rise buildings. There are still plenty of under-construction facilities. JVC is home to cutting-edge mid-rise buildings and renowned hotels. 

The company, the project’s developer, aimed to create a space that was pleasant for living as well as resting and unwinding. There are three nurseries, a university, a school, a hospital, and a shopping mall. There are numerous green zones and parks with playgrounds in the area. Because of this, renting out a residence in JVC is a fantastic idea. Rental income brings in 6.8%, one of the highest rates in Dubai, the United Arab Emirates.

There will undoubtedly be a park close by, regardless of the residence or apartment you reside in. After all, 33 parks are spread out in a small housing complex with an area of 8 km². Some of them are rather small and are only suitable for a playground or benches under trees. However, some of them like Circle Community Park or JVC Community Park, can be referred to as completely green parks. There are green spaces here for people of all ages. The housing development features dog parks and playgrounds. Since there is also a pet-friendly cafe where pets are welcome, the location is perfect for pet owners overall.
